review.verdict: The diptych layout and human/robot casting are clean, but the central left-side gag — a chatbot's arrow pointing at the wrong ballot box — is illegible (no box drawn, arrow prop is a tiny unreadable squiggle), and the 'fused sign' on the right reads as a plain three-word line rather than two merged signs, so the specific joke doesn't land in 3 seconds.
revisionNotes: Add a visible ballot-box component on the left (raw shape, scale ~1.3) and enlarge the boxarrow prop (currently ~35px, reads as a stray cable) so the crooked arrow clearly points at it — this is the whole left-side joke and it's currently illegible.
Draw an actual voting booth (curtain or frame shape around the voter) so the scene reads as a polling place, not an open field.

Make the 'fused sign' visually read as two merged signs — overlap two label shapes for AI TOOLS and SEARCH with a visible seam, shared letter, or split color, instead of one plain run-on line of text floating above the roof.
Anchor the sign directly over the schoolhouse door (attachTo door, not roof-top) to close the gap and read as a building sign.

Re-pose the teacher so the reaching arm angles up toward the sign (pose: reach/point-up) instead of out to the side mirroring the voter's shrug — currently it doesn't connect to the fused sign at all.
Composition and cast (human voter/teacher, robot chatbot, building institution) are solid — keep the symmetrical diptych and divider once the props above are fixed.

review.verdict: Fails: the teacher's head sits directly in front of the fused AI TOOLS/SEARCH sign, garbling the key punchline text, and the scene leaves nearly half the canvas as empty sky and ground while echoing a recent split-composition/palette too closely.
revisionNotes: Critical: move teacher's head anchor down/left so it doesn't sit in front of the fused sign — the sign currently reads 'AI TO[face]ARCH', unreadable. Shift teacher to x≈0.60, y≈0.80 or shrink/raise the sign so the two labels clear the head entirely.

Composition wastes the top ~45% and bottom ~20% of the canvas as empty beige/teal; raise the booth, robot, and schoolhouse scale to ~1.15-1.2 and move their vertical anchor up to y≈0.62 so the scene fills more of the square.

Novelty is low: the center-divider diptych and teal/orange/cream palette closely echo a recent slopper's split-building layout — differentiate with an asymmetric composition or a different accent palette (e.g., swap teal ground for a muted plum or mustard).
Add a small ground detail (shadow, footprints, or texture break) in the lower teal band so it doesn't read as empty dead space.
Arrow from chatbot slightly overlaps the ballot box lid at an awkward angle; nudge offset down ~10px so the arrowhead lands cleanly inside the slot instead of clipping the box edge.
Once the head/sign overlap is fixed, double-check 'SEARCH' and 'AI TOOLS' are both fully legible at thumbnail size — enlarge label scale to 1.1 if needed.
